prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely
plan.description: A fast, practical guide to changing a flat tire: park safe, loosen the nuts, lift the car, swap the wheel. Learn the one mistake that makes it dangerous.

beats.narration: A flat tire doesn't have to ruin your day. First, park on flat, solid ground, turn on your hazard lights, and pull the parking brake.

props.text: Flat tire? Park flat. Hazards on.

beats.narration: Next, loosen the lug nuts a little while the wheel is still on the ground. Don't remove them yet. That's the step people skip.
Then place the jack under the car's frame, near the flat, and lift until the tire clears the ground. Remove the nuts and swap the wheel.
Finally, tighten the nuts in a star pattern, lower the car, and tighten again. Never get under a car held by a jack.
